$comment: This deployment is a static SPA only. The app ships from .github/workflows/deploy-pages.yml and every server route is a Supabase Edge Function (.github/workflows/deploy-functions.yml); the browser talks to those at an absolute URL, not through /api here. The old api/ tree — a second, parallel copy of the payment and admin logic — was deleted with the ZENGAPAY migration, so there are no Serverless Functions to declare, no rewrites to map, and no crons. Settlement is driven by feed-settle on a scheduler.
